verdict.rationale: Trello's own docs and community reports cover all three parts of the story, but each only thinly. Docs describe tracking tasks on cards and creating cards (including by email), and setting due dates on cards and checklist items. Hands-on users praise how easily people can be added to cards. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of assigning members to cards, in-depth docs on native card due dates (current evidence comes from Power-Up listings), and hands-on corroboration of due-date use.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create tasks and assign them to teammates with due dates

citations.quote: Track progress of tasks in one convenient place with a visual layout that adds 'ta-da' to your to-do's.
